events.body:
## Context

`package.json` runs `tailwindcss -i css/input.css -o css/styles.css` and `tailwind.config.js` has `content: ['./*.html']`, but everything moved to `public/`. `npm run build` now fails or produces CSS with every utility purged, so nobody can change styling safely.

## What to do

1. Change the scripts to `-i public/css/input.css -o public/css/styles.css`.
2. Set `content: ['./public/**/*.html']`.
3. Rebuild and commit `public/css/styles.css`.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] `npm install && npm run build` succeeds
- [ ] Rebuilt CSS still contains classes the pages use (e.g. `grid-cols-3`)
- [ ] Pages look the same

## How to test locally

```bash
cd blt-ketchup && npm install && npm run build && python3 -m http.server -d public 8000   # then open http://localhost:8000
```
